Both lanes run this for every task. Any index- or HEAD-mutating verification (`git revert`, `git reset`, `git stash`, bare `git add`) is a cross-lane write when the two lanes share one working tree and one index, so the compliance step itself is the hazard. Corrective action for lane-2, effective immediately and to be written into the sections lane-2 owns: (1) rollback verification must be WORKTREE-ONLY -- reverse-apply with `git apply -R`, run the task's L0 gate, then restore with `git apply`; never `git revert`/`git reset`/`git stash`. (2) every commit uses `git commit -- <explicit paths>` (converges with lane-1's corrective action). (3) radius commands must be pathspec-scoped to the lane's declared file set, since a bare `git diff --stat HEAD` reports 204 pre-existing modified files and cannot measure one task's radius. These three become normative text in DEV-PROTOCOL section R2 (TF-0106, L0/L1 gate definition) and section R3 (TF-0107, per-task radius closeout), both owned by lane-2.

observed_action_or_result: 实现对两个信号做了不同处置。onclose：摘除 session + invalidate memo + logWarn + fire-and-forget disposeSession（完全按字面）。onerror：只 invalidate memo，不摘除 session、不 dispose。理由：transport 对可恢复错误同样 fire onerror（SSE/streamable-http 的瞬时网络错误、stdio 的畸形消息、非致命协议错误），而摘除 session 会连带 disposeSession —— 对 stdio 传输那意味着杀掉一个仍在运行的子进程。按字面实现会在瞬时错误上摧毁健康服务器，即用一个更严重的故障替换本 task 要修的故障。
